desc: Read input, store A modulo p, count zeros K; if p == 1 print N lines of zeros and exit.
For p == 2, replace every zero by 1, compute B^2 modulo 2 with matrix multiplication, print, and exit.
Implement optimized modular matrix multiplication and binary exponentiation to compute A^p modulo p for odd p.
For odd p, initialize result with A^p; for every zero position (r,c), add column c of A to result[:,c] and add row r of A to result[r,:], reducing modulo p.
If p == 3, for every zero off-diagonal position (r,c), additionally add A[c][r] to result[r][c] modulo p.
Multiply every entry by p-1 if K is odd, otherwise by 1, then print the matrix.
Run the three sample tests; if any fail, debug formula/sign/orientation or switch to a different derivation.
Validate against brute-force enumeration for tiny N,p,K to catch sign and p=3 orientation errors.
If matrix exponentiation is too slow, optimize multiplication (transpose, sparse skip, or alternative polynomial method) and retest.
